contact.basis: Fixed exterior point just beyond western bridge end selected before terrain and geometry, not a surveyed deck/water/pier datum.

verticalDatum: Public Terrarium composite source heights; provider-relative host visualization, not a surveyed local datum.
attribution: Mapzen terrain tiles; NASA/USGS and other open elevation sources
method: Original Terrarium RGB24 bytes bilinearly sampled at pixel centres in fixed native whole Puente Colgante Santa Fe frame. Independent field frozen before any model geometry, without flattening or fitting.
limitations: Terrarium zoom15 output pixels may oversample much coarser native DEM.4m review grid and RGB encoding are not survey accuracy.

Coarse urban composite may not resolve river bathymetry/water stage, pile embedment or narrow abutment grades; exact construction-grade classification is unspecified. Compatible host field required; default coarse terrain is not automatically certified.
